alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:49aaa88c-7.title: Sales Development Representative - Inbound
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:49aaa88c-7.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE As an Inbound Sales Development Representative at Baseten, you'll be the first point of contact for prospects who've shown interest in Baseten - quickly engaging, understanding their needs, and qualifying them against our ideal customer profile. You'll turn inbound interest into qualified pipeline. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build revenue pipeline by setting introductory meetings with potential businesses and key decision makers. - Diligently respond to inbound inquiries and determine potential product fit. - Help influence Baseten's product roadmap for customers and prospects. - Identify high-potential businesses and verticals and develop and execute outbound strategies to bring them to Baseten. - Stay up-to-date on market trends, competition, and industry developments. - Manage and document the progression of the sales pipeline. - Drive pre- & post-engagement at industry events (will attend multiple events in person). REQUIREMENTS - Ability to develop strong, long-lasting relationships both internally and externally. - Collaborative and coachable, always looking to improve your skills and impact. - Ability to handle rejection and stay persistent in pursuing leads. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - A basic understanding of a standard SaaS seller's technical stack (CRM, Outreach/Salesloft, Prospect Research, etc.). - Excellent time management, process, and prioritization skills. - Preferred experience with Cloud or Security sales. BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:0b.title: HR Specialist
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:0b.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking an experienced and dynamic HR Office Admin to oversee Human Resource aspects related to these critical operations. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the compliance and organization of our rapid response and storm chasing services, supporting our mission to provide reliable and effective solutions to utility companies facing emergencies and adverse weather conditions.
responsibilities: Employee File Management:
Ensure employee job data is entered timely and maintained in company’s core HRMS system, Paychex Flex with accuracy according to company policy.
Manage various employee forms and ensure appropriate documentation as well as approvals are obtained.
Ensure driver files are created for new employees in a timely manner and all documentation is properly obtained, organized, & maintained.
Ensure appropriate updates are being made or acquired based upon local, state, & federal guidelines as well as company or employee requests.
Employee Recruitment & Onboarding:
Oversee end-to-end hiring processes from identifying hiring needs to onboarding of the hired candidate.
Administer the interview process for potential candidates and coordinate with division managers to ensure proper candidate screenings and assessments.
Manage all recruiting platforms and review job postings, candidates, and opportunities with division and senior managers.
Ensure all employee inquiries are organized and filed according to company policy.
Oversee, schedule, and participate in a rotation of employee onboarding outside business hours to support emergency operations.
Ensure activation of new employees in the HRMS system, Paychex Flex
Ensure all DOT driver qualifications are met according to onboarding compliance.
Review employee benefit packages bi-annually and ensure all eligible employees are enrolled or removed timely and accurately.
Performance Monitoring:
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of employee productivity, storm chasing and restoration efforts.
Monitor KPIs regularly and implement corrective actions as needed to meet performance targets.
Analyze performance data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Implement an employee evaluation schedule and ensure completion of employee reviews in a timely manner across the organization.
Prepares and maintains special internal and external reports as requested by the Manager and/or Director of Human Resources
Compliance and Governance:

Ensure statutory, regulatory, ethical, contractual and policy compliance consistent with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations, enterprise values and code of conduct, collective bargaining agreements and human resources policies and procedures.
Oversee any human resource internal and external audits, addressing audit findings and recommendations.
Uphold corporate governance principles and ethical standards.
Maintain hiring practice completion in accordance with company guidelines and all legal agency requirements (Federal, State, DOT, OSHA)
Act as a liaison with outside agencies and other human resources functions and company support services throughout the organization.
Develops, revises, and implements HR policies and procedures.
Reporting and Communication:
First line of support for field staff and Management related to inquiries regarding workforce data (rate changes, separations, and employee movement)
Communicate with managers, and field staff on employee documentation and onboarding needs.
Ensure all updated local union documentation is obtained as needed and changes are communicated to corresponding parties.
Advises management on the formulation and administration of plans and policies for human resource activities.
Acts as an internal consultant by analyzing and recommending solutions to human resource issues relating to the assigned program or business area.
Reviews payroll information and reporting to ensure timely and accurate payments to employees.
Collaborates with managers and senior leaders on budgets, expenses, and efficiencies related to payroll.
qualifications: Associate degree in Human Resources or related field preferred
Proven experience in accurate and dependable HR functions
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel)
Ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive financial and payroll information
Proficient in Payroll operations
Team player mindset
Effective communication
Strong organization skills

distro-distro:lever:28c88805-7d07-45e1-9.description: 🚀 Senior Accountant We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to join our team in a fully remote role. This position will lead day-to-day bookkeeping activities and support the preparation and review of U.S. tax returns. The ideal candidate has strong experience with U.S. tax compliance, bookkeeping, and reviewing the work of other team members while maintaining high quality standards. 💰 Salary: USD $1,655/month 🏠 Modality: Fully Remote 💼 Employment Type: Full-Time 🕒 Work Schedule: • Monday to Friday • 6:30 AM to 2:30 PM (Philippine Time) 🎯 Key Responsibilities: Bookkeeping & Accounting • Perform and review bookkeeping activities, including transaction coding, account reconciliations, and cleanup projects. • Maintain general ledger accuracy and oversee month-end close processes. • Prepare and review workpapers and supporting documentation according to company standards. Tax Compliance & Review • Prepare U.S. individual and business tax returns. • Support tax planning and tax compliance projects. • Review tax returns prepared by team members for accuracy, completeness, and proper documentation. • Identify discrepancies, risks, and tax-saving opportunities, escalating complex issues when necessary. Quality Control & Coaching • Provide detailed review notes and constructive feedback to team members. • Help improve preparer accuracy, consistency, and overall work quality. Client & Engagement Management • Request, track, and follow up on outstanding client information. • Identify missing documentation early to keep engagements on schedule. Team Collaboration & Process Improvement • Work closely with internal team members to resolve accounting and tax-related questions. • Support workflow management, file organization, and process improvement initiatives. 🛠️ Qualifications: • 3 to 6 years of U.S. tax and bookkeeping experience. • Experience preparing U.S. individual and business tax returns. • Strong knowledge of bookkeeping principles, reconciliations, and month-end close procedures. • Experience reviewing the work of other accountants or tax preparers. • Ability to identify issues, provide solutions, and maintain high-quality standards. • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Experience with QuickBooks Online is preferred. • Experience with Lacerte tax software is preferred. 💰 Perks & Benefits: • 100% remote work environment. • Consistent weekday schedule with work-life balance. • Opportunity to work with U.S.-based accounting and tax engagements. • Collaborative and professional team environment. • Career growth and leadership development opportunities. #SolvoGlobal #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Remote

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:6df99df3-.description: About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. Join our multicultural team of visionaries and industry rebels in disrupting the traditional finance industry! You will prototype, implement and experiment with machine learning methods to solve business use cases. You will lead efforts to automate, architect and optimise machine learning processes and workflows. You will also help define, execute and enforce best practices for test-driven model development processes for the entire Data Science team in MoneyLion. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:00efefe7-2a8.title: GTM Automation Engineer, Outbound Marketing
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:00efefe7-2a8.description: About Wing Wing is one of the world’s largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco. Leveraging our global scale, millions of applicants, and deep operational expertise, we’re now building next-generation AI and automation products. Across both sides of our business, we help companies automate workflows, scale revenue, and unlock world-class global talent. As part of this evolution, we are building a high-scale outbound engine to reach SMBs and mid-market companies at scale. This requires a new kind of role - one that blends engineering, automation, experiment velocity, and GTM execution. About the Role We are hiring a full-time GTM Automation Engineer to architect, automate, and optimize our outbound growth systems. This is a hybrid role combining Clay automation expertise, light engineering, outbound infrastructure, experimentation, and crisp copywriting. You will build and maintain the machine behind our outbound engine: Clay workflows, enrichment pipelines, domain infrastructure, multi-tool integrations, personalization systems, and data dashboards. You will run high-velocity experiments, write conversion-focused outbound copy, troubleshoot deliverability, and scale sending volume across hundreds of thousands of leads. You will work closely with our marketing, product, and sales teams - but you will own your domain with a high degree of autonomy. The systems you build will directly drive pipeline, revenue, and go-to-market strategy. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role that sits at the intersection of engineering and growth. The impact you make here will be massive. Responsibilities You will own the entire outbound automation machine, including: 1. Clay Workflows & Lead Infrastructure - Build advanced Clay workflows for scraping, enrichment, verification, scoring, routing, and personalization - Use APIs, webhooks, and custom code steps to automate data pipelines - Create ICP logic, trigger systems, and multi-step lead flows 2. Multi-Domain Email Infrastructure, Deliverability, Verification - Set up hundreds, up to thousands of domains, warming, DNS, DMARC, DKIM, SPF - Build scalable campaign systems in Instantly using Apollo data - Know the ins and outs of email verification: LeadMagic, BounceBan, and more - Maintain deliverability and sending health across all domains - Implement verification, cleansing, and bounce prevention 3. Experiments & Optimization - Ship several outbound experiments per week, measure results - Test variations of copy, subject lines, offers, personas - Build dashboards to track open → reply → meeting → revenue - Identify bottlenecks and improve system performance continuously 4. Copywriting & Messaging - Write clear outbound emails and short-form sequences - Use Clay’s AI rewriting + dynamic variables for deep personalization - Create persona-based messaging frameworks 5. Data & Engineering Tasks - Write small scripts (Python, JavaScript) when needed - Integrate tools through API calls and workflows - Clean, transform, and normalize data - Maintain accurate metrics and reporting Outcomes You Will Be Accountable For Scaling outbound sending volume from 5k → 50k → 250k+ emails/month Improving reply rates and meeting-booked rates through experimentation Reducing cost per qualified meeting Building a predictable outbound funnel that feeds Sales every day Ensuring strong deliverability across all domains and systems Automating manual steps so the outbound engine becomes self-sustaining Requirements Must-Have - Expert-level Clay experience (advanced formulas, automations, integrations) - Strong experience with Apollo and Instantly - Ability to write clean, concise outbound copy in English - Experience setting up email domains, DNS, verification, warming - Ability to write scripts with Python/JS - Strong data skills (normalization, dedupe, cleansing, schema design) - Experience running large-scale outbound campaigns - Strong analytical and experimentation mindset -

jobgether-jobgether:lever:25e62668-40cd-.title: Welsh Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:25e62668-40cd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Welsh Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Brazil. This is an opportunity for an experienced Welsh voice professional to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice technologies. You’ll use your performance expertise to help create training data that enables AI systems to communicate with greater naturalness, accuracy, and expression. The role combines professional voice recording with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and detailed feedback on AI-generated speech. You’ll assess pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation to help improve Welsh voice models. Working with advanced AI tools, you’ll contribute to refining prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines. The project offers a flexible freelance environment where your linguistic and performance expertise can have a global impact. It’s particularly suited to a detail-oriented voice actor who is passionate about language, technology, and shaping more human-like AI experiences. Record scripted training material in Welsh with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, and appropriate vocal expression. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, fluency, naturalness, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and emotional expression. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated voice outputs. Provide detailed expert feedback to help improve the quality, authenticity, and usability of Welsh voice models. Assess regional and linguistic variations to help ensure AI-generated speech reflects natural Welsh communication. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, and voice design guidelines. Apply professional voice acting expertise to produce consistent, high-quality training data. Follow recording, quality, annotation, and project guidelines accurately and consistently. Contribute insights based on professional experience in voice performance, narration, dubbing, or related fields. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Welsh voice acting , dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Welsh language ability with strong command of pronunciation, intonation, rhythm, and natural expression. Strong ability to deliver scripted content consistently while maintaining clarity, authenticity, and appropriate emotional tone. Excellent attention to detail when evaluating speech quality, linguistic accuracy, and subtle pronunciation or delivery differences. Strong written and verbal communication skills for providing clear, actionable feedback. Ability to work independently and reliably in a freelance project environment. Experience with voice recording, audio evaluation, linguistic annotation, training, or coaching is a plus. Comfortable working with AI tools and evaluating AI-generated speech. Access to a high-quality recording setup , including a reliable microphone and quiet recording environment. Secure computer and stable internet connection suitable for remote project work. Benefits Freelance contract with a flexible remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to the development of advanced AI voice and language technologies. Ability to apply your professional Welsh voice expertise to a global technology project. Pay range of $6 to $65 per hour , with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI tools and contribute to improving voice technology. Flexible project-based environment suited to experienced independent professionals. Please note that the role is contract-based and does not include company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance or paid time off .
